value.rationale: The prime-power lower index is an extremal canonical subfamily for the original progression-gcd problem. Determining all individual first nonzero p-adic digits gives uniform sharp modular information genuinely finer than both gcd-one and exact gcd-valuation classifications, and a usable first precision layer for linear combinations or future congruence lifting.
